Description:

[color=#6d9eeb][size=6][u][b][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776454-869883807.png[/img][/b][/u][/size][/color][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial][size=2]Ever looked at your farmhouse at night and wished you could light up those last few corners? Look no further![/size]

[size=2]This mod adds Incorporeal light sources! You can walk through it and you can't see it! Now you can light up your whole house without the need for Json Assets or Spacecore![/size]

[size=2]Once you've got your house how you want it looking except you notice areas that could use some more light, place down a few incorporeal lamps in those dark corners![/size]

[size=2]Using the config you can choose which vanilla game lamps become incorporeal. One, none, all, or some. The choice is yours! By default, only the [/size][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Candle_Lamp]Candle Lamp[/url][size=2] is made incorporeal.[/size]

[b][u][color=#f1c232][size=5]Read Before Using:
[/size][/color][/u][/b][color=#f1c232]1)[/color][size=2] Get your whole house set up exactly how you want it.[/size]
[color=#f1c232]2)[/color][size=2] Sleep to save, close your game and open the config, set the lamp you want incorporeal as "true" in the config (it will make [/size][u][b]ALL[/b][/u][size=2] instances of this lamp incorporeal).[/size]
[color=#f1c232]3) [/color][size=2]Re-Open SDV and load your save, open the catalogue or wherever you are getting the lamps in-game and click them to add them to your inventory. Note that you wont be able to see them in your inventory but you will be able to scroll to them with your mouse wheel.[/size]
[color=#f1c232]4)[/color][size=2] Place the lamps where you want. [/size][color=#ff0000]The very upper left pixel of the square you place them in will [b][u]NOT[/u][/b] be incorporeal.[/color][size=2] It will still be impossible to walk through if you attempt to walk directly into the corner of the square. For this reason I recommend that you place the lamps up against the left-hand side of an open space so that the right-most square of some other object (like a table) touches the incorporeal lamp. For example, if you had a 2 by 1 kitchen table and you wanted to put a lamp near it, you would want the order of squares (reading from left to right) be table, table, lamp. You would [/size][b][u]NOT[/u][/b][size=2] want it to be lamp, table, table because that would leave the 1 remaining corporeal pixel floating off to the left of the table blocking your path if you tried to walk in between the two tiles to the left of the table.[/size]
[color=#f1c232]5)[/color][size=2] Once you place a lamp, it's there [/size][b][u]PERMANENTLY[/u][/b][size=2]! Don't save until after you're sure it all looks how you want it to. [/size][color=#ff0000]You [b]CANNOT[/b] pick up the lamps after you place it![/color]
[color=#f1c232]6) [/color][size=2]You can place other objects on top of the lamps and they still produce light. So if you put one down accidentally and then saved before you were sure. You can rearrange your furniture layout to put a piece of furniture over the lamp to cover up the 1 still corporeal pixel.[/size]

[size=2][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/11143/11143-1658186429-1273591401.png[/img][/size]
[size=2](Larger image in the "Images" tab above)[/size]


[b][u][color=#f1c232][size=5]Config Options:[/size][/color][/u][/b]
[i][size=3]“[LAMPNAMEGOESHERE]LampIncorporeal”: [color=#ff00ff]"true"[/color][/size][/i]
[size=2]Allows you to [/size][color=#ff00ff]edit[/color][size=2] which lamps are changed by my mod. Change “[/size][color=#00ff00]true[/color][size=2]” to “[/size][color=#ff0000]false[/color][size=2]” if you would like that lamp to be turned incorporeal by my mod. [/size][b][color=#f1c232][size=3]
[i]
NOTE: [/i][/size][/color][/b][size=2]Incorporeal means not able to touch or see, so once you place the lamp it may be difficult to find it to pick it up. Be [b][u][i]SURE[/i][/u][/b] before you save your game after placing incorporeal lamps as you cannot place other objects inside a lamp once the lamp is placed.[/size]




[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645779750-777928429.png[/img]
[size=2][color=#f1c232][b]1)[/b] [/color]Install and/or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains an assets folder as well as a config.json, content.json, & manifest.json file) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Incorporeal Lamps"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]




[/font][u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776467-497634449.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/u]
[font=Arial][size=2][size=2]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.4, 1.5.5 and 1.5.6 [/size]CONFIRMED[size=2]. Probably works with earlier versions as well but I haven't tested it with anything less than 1.5.4.[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Windows and macOS (I have not tested it on Linux but I don't see why it wouldn't work there too)[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Single-player and Multiplayer.

[/size]Compatible with any building! Place in the greenhouse, barn, coop, farmhouse. Place it in any building!

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
-No mod [b]conflicts[/b] that I know of yet.
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=2][b]
-Issues [/b]may arise if you have any other mods installed that LOAD the same files. 

[/size][/font]-I added three zzz at the beginning of the name in the manifest which will force this mod to load very last allowing it to overwrite any other furniture mods that edit whichever lamps you choose to make incorporeal. That means this SHOULD be compatible with everything.
